6. 設 k 為一常數。 解方程 (x - k)² = 4k² 。

A. x = 3k
B. x = 5k
C. x = -k 或 x = 3k
D. x = -3k 或 x = 5k
reasoning: Given the equation (x - k)² = 4k², taking the square root of both sides gives x - k = ±√(4k²), which simplifies to x - k = ±2k. Solving for x in both cases: (1) x - k = 2k leads to x = 3k; (2) x - k = -2k leads to x = -k. Therefore, x = -k or x = 3k, which corresponds to option C.
